title: Bloom Library: Multimodal Datasets in 300+ Languages for a Variety of Downstream Tasks
measurement_description: The paper measures the composition of its datasets, noting a content bias towards Christian books and Bible stories among the religious materials included.
findings: The paper found that among the religious materials included in the Bloom Library datasets, there is a bias towards Christian books and Bible stories.
